ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface area; high-intensity (white) pixels are limited to approximately 5-8% of the fluke surface, localized exclusively within thin linear striations.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous dark pigmentation across the entire visible surface; no contiguous white geometric blobs or mottling are present. High-contrast mapping is restricted to fine-line linear patterns on both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped notch with an estimated obtuse angle of 145 degrees; vertical pixel depth is approximately 1/10th of the vertical height of the visible lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations present along the continuous trailing boundary; notable jagged pixel clusters located on the distal half of the left lobe's trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge shows a consistent concave curve trajectory from the median notch toward the distal tips of the lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense clusters of parallel and intersecting high-contrast white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) distributed across the mid-section of the left lobe and distal section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake mark scarring appearing as parallel white lines; minor irregular tissue indentations along the trailing edge.
